name: Microsoft To Do
label: Microsoft Graph To Do
description: Microsoft Graph To Do via OfficialApiNode (nodes/microsoft-to-do/api_spec.json). Official Graph To Do v1.0. Tasks.Read / Tasks.ReadWrite. App-only uses /users/{id} — this spec uses /me (delegated). Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/todo-overview?view=graph-rest-1.0. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Microsoft To Do official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"task_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'task_create', 'task_get', 'task_list', 'task_update', 'task_delete', 'list_create', 'list_get', 'list_list', 'list_update', 'list_delete', 'linked_resource_create', 'linked_resource_get', 'linked_resource_list', 'linked_resource_update', 'linked_resource_delete'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'task_create'.

schema.label: list_id
schema.description: To Do task-list id for task_* and list_*. Example: AAMkAGI2...

schema.label: title
schema.description: Task title for task_create / task_update. Example: Review invoice.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Task body {contentType, content} for task_create / task_update. Example: {"contentType":"text","content":"Follow up"}.

schema.label: importance
schema.description: task_create importance. EXACT: low | normal | high.

schema.label: task_id
schema.description: To Do task id. Example: AAMkAGI2...AAA=

schema.label: status
schema.description: task_update status. EXACT: notStarted | inProgress | completed | waitingOnOthers | deferred.

schema.label: displayName
schema.description: List displayName (list_create/update) or linked-resource display name.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: task_create, task_get, task_list, task_update, task_delete, list_create, list_get, list_list, list_update, list_delete, linked_resource_create, linked_resource_get, linked_resource_list, linked_resource_update, linked_resource_delete. Default: task_create. Example: task_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
